summary.one_liner: A curated link list of monitoring tools and resources, covering traditional data-center monitoring (Nagios family, Zabbix, Ganglia), APM and metrics/logging/tracing stacks, and incident management.
summary.what_it_does: This is an "awesome"-style list rather than a software project. It is organized into sections: DC Monitoring (Nagios, Zabbix, Ganglia, Zenoss, Opserver, Netdata, HertzBeat), Nagios Monitoring (Icinga, Naemon, Shinken, Centreon, Opsview, Check_mk, Sensu and others), Zabbix Monitoring (plugin and addon placeholders, currently empty), APM Monitoring (collectors, backends, alerting, dashboards), Distributed Tracing (OpenTelemetry, Zipkin, Jaeger, Sentry, Pinpoint, SkyWalking, Uptrace), API (super-devops, go-devops), and Incident management (harpia). The Nagios section is the largest, with nested subsections for plugins by target (databases, storage, network, virtualization), agents (NRPE, NCPA, NSClient++), event brokers, visualization front-ends, metric storage and graphing, configuration tools, and addon APIs. Most entries are a name plus a one-line description and a link to a project or GitHub page.
use_cases: Finding a Nagios-compatible monitoring plugin for a specific service
Choosing metrics collectors and time-series backends
Locating APM and distributed tracing tools
Finding Nagios dashboards, graphing, or agents
Discovering incident management and alert aggregation tools
notable: Organized by category, with Nagios plugins grouped by monitored target (database, storage, network, virtualization, SNMP)
Lists agents, event brokers, visualization, and metric forwarding tools for the Nagios ecosystem
Covers both traditional DC monitoring and modern APM/tracing tools
Links to official sites alongside GitHub source repositories
caveats: Links only; no software is installed or run from this repository
Many entries are bare names with no description, and some sections are empty (Zabbix plugins and addons, Monitoring BigData)
Some entries are duplicated across sections (for example, New Relic, javamelody, and kamon appear under both Collector and Backend tracing) and some links may be stale
